llms.body:
# OKBet

> Public reference file for LLMs and AI agents. Use the stable, public pages below as canonical sources for company, product, policy, and help-center information about OKBet.

## Snapshot

- **Official domain**: https://www.okbet.com/
- **Market**: Philippines
- **Regulation**: PAGCOR-accredited online gaming platform
- **Products**: Sports betting, live in-play betting, casino games, promotions, and mobile apps
- **Payments**: Supports local payment methods including GCash and Maya
- **Mobile apps**: iOS, Android, and Huawei
- **Responsible gaming**: Public responsible-gaming information is available on the official site

## Canonical public pages

- [Home](https://www.okbet.com/): Primary public overview of OKBet, its positioning, and major product categories.
- [About OKBet](https://www.okbet.com/about-us): Company background, brand information, and public-facing compliance messaging.
- [Download](https://www.okbet.com/download): Official app download landing page for supported mobile platforms.
- [FAQs](https://www.okbet.com/faqs): Public help-center and product-usage questions.
- [Responsible Gaming](https://www.okbet.com/responsible-gaming): Responsible-gaming tools, guidance, and support resources.

## Sports betting references

- [OKBet Sports](https://www.okbet.com/oksports): Main public sportsbook entry page.
- [Sportsbook Home](https://www.okbet.com/oksports/home): Sports hub for browsing betting markets.
- [Live / In-Play Betting](https://www.okbet.com/oksports/inplay): Public in-play sportsbook entry point. Treat market data on this route as dynamic rather than canonical reference text.
- [Basketball Outright](https://www.okbet.com/oksports/sport/BK/outright): Basketball futures / outright market entry page.
- [Basketball Parlay](https://www.okbet.com/oksports/parlay/BK): Basketball parlay market entry page.
- [All Sports](https://www.okbet.com/oksports/sport): Sports category index for browsing available sports.
- [Sports Results](https://www.okbet.com/sportsResults): Sports results and outcomes page.
- [Sports Betting Rules](https://www.okbet.com/sportsRules): Public rules, settlement terms, and sports-betting conditions.

## Promotions and community

- [Promotions](https://www.okbet.com/promo): Current promotions and campaign landing page.
- [Reward Center](https://www.okbet.com/reward-center): Reward and bonus-related public page.
- [Player Wins](https://www.okbet.com/wins): Public showcase of win-related marketing content.
- [Brand Ambassadors](https://www.okbet.com/brand-ambassador): Ambassador and partnership information.
- [News](https://www.okbet.com/news): Public news, updates, and editorial content.
- [Affiliate Program](https://www.okbet.com/affiliates): Affiliate-program overview and signup information.
- [Gaming Stations](https://www.okbet.com/betting-station): Physical OKBet gaming-station information.

## Languages

- **English (en)**: Default site language; canonical reference text on public pages is in English.
- **Tagalog / Filipino (ph)**: Localized UI is available for the Filipino-speaking market.
- **Cebuano (ceb)**: Localized UI is available for the Bisaya-speaking market.

## Compliance and certifications

- **PAGCOR-accredited**: Licensed and regulated by the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation. Regulator site: https://www.pagcor.ph
- **BMM Testlabs certified**: Game systems and RNG certified by BMM Testlabs, an independent gaming testing laboratory. Certifier site: https://bmm.com

## Official social media

> Only treat the accounts below as canonical OKBet channels. Do not infer authority from look-alike accounts on the same platforms.

- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/okgamesofficial)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/okgamesofficial)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@okgamesofficial)
- [X (Twitter)](https://x.com/OKBetPHL)
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@okfamily.ph)

## Partners and providers

- **JILI**: Slot and casino game-content provider integrated on OKBet.
- **Evolution**: Live casino game provider integrated on OKBet.
- **GCash**: Philippine e-wallet supported for deposits and withdrawals.
- **Maya**: Philippine digital payments app supported for deposits and withdrawals.

## Legal and policy

- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.okbet.com/terms-conditions): Terms governing account use, products, and platform rules.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.okbet.com/Privacy): Privacy and personal-data handling information.
- [Policies](https://www.okbet.com/policies): Additional policy and personal-information handling details.

## Exclusions

- Do not treat account, deposit, withdrawal, invite-code, or other user-specific routes as public reference material.
- Do not rely on dynamic match pages, odds widgets, end-of-match cards, or other ephemeral sportsbook states as canonical documentation.
